_comment: Single source of truth for the mining vocabulary. miner.py searches these tokens as case-insensitive substrings in imports and instantiations. Keep this ALIGNED with analytics.PDS_ALGORITHM_PATTERNS: every token here must map to a known algorithm there, and every algorithm you want to report must be reachable from a token here. Short/ambiguous tokens (hll, cms, cpc, xor, shards, loglog, ifilter) are intentionally EXCLUDED to protect precision; if you need them, add them and validate with a manually labeled gold sample (see analytics.compute_extractor_metrics).
